title: Kids Nature Scavenger Hunt Printable, Hiking Activity Pack, Trail Bingo, Junior Hiker Journal, Family Hike Game, Ages 4-10, Outdoor Kids
description:
Help kids enjoy the hike instead of asking "are we there yet". This 24-page printable pack turns any trail into a game, season by season, for ages 4 to 10.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Four seasonal scavenger hunts (fall, winter, spring, summer), each in three levels: easy, tricky and expert
- Trail bingo for any season and a five senses walk
- Trail sign and blaze spotter page
- My trail rules in kid words: stay with the group, stop at junctions, hug a tree and blow your whistle if lost
- Leave No Trace for kids
- Junior hiker journal pages: draw what you saw, how far you went, how you felt
- Hike count tracker and a Junior Trail Explorer certificate
- A short how-to page for grown-ups with print tips
- Distances in miles and kilometers

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
For personal and family use. Kids should always hike with a grown-up.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
